item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-26
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. Notably, the `statcheck` and `escicheck` projects have made updates, with `statcheck` merging the `feature-non-apa-newer` branch and `escicheck` synchronizing its `main` branch with the `escicheckapp` repository. Meanwhile, `oddpub` has improved its ontogenerator's code validation, and `docpluck` has addressed several issues, including adding diagnostics and fixing rendering problems. The `coarse` project has re-enabled Fable 5 in the model picker, and `regcheck` has made multiple updates, including fixing bugs and renaming survey routes to avoid ad blocker interference. These connections between projects highlight the collaborative spirit of our community, and we celebrate the progress being made to enhance our open-source research tools.

item.title: metacheck: 1 commit today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

The `data_check` branch was the focus of recent work, where a commit on July 26 added an RO-crate metadata file, replacing the existing collection.json, and also removed the full preview from the archive, while fixing regex bugs. On the same `data_check` branch, an earlier commit on July 22 added a "reproducibility_check" feature. No other branches were worked on during this period. The changes to the `data_check` branch aimed to modify the metadata handling and enhance the checking capabilities. The removal of the full preview from the archive suggests a change in how data is presented or accessed. The `data_check` branch is the only branch that received updates.

1 commit(s) today:
